{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Xeno Multi Limpet Controller''' is an optional internal module that programmes ordinary limpets for '''decontamination''', '''repair''', or '''research''' work. It combines the three functions in one Class 3 compartment and can control up to four active limpets in total.<ref name="update9">Frontier Developments, [https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/elite-dangerous-odyssey-update-9-notes.595180/ Elite Dangerous: Odyssey Update 9 notes], 9 December 2021.</ref><ref name="edwiki">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Xeno_Multi_Limpet_Controller Xeno Multi Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

== Specifications ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Module
! Mass
! Integrity
! Power draw
! Maximum active limpets
|-
| 3C || 10 t || 68 || 0.35 MW || 4
|-
| 3B || 15 t || 80 || 0.30 MW || 4
|}

The 3C variant is lighter. The 3B variant has greater integrity and slightly lower power draw, but adds five tonnes of mass. Both occupy a Class 3 optional compartment and provide the same four-limpet maximum.<ref name="edcd">EDCD, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/6b26af015ebc270e935af3362fea48ad56056e59/modules/internal/multi_limpet_controllers.json Multi Limpet Controller data], commit pinned; accessed 23 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edsm">EDSM, [https://www.edsm.net/en/faq/outfitting/index/id/5/name/Optional+Internal/sub/Multi+Limpet+Controller Optional Internal — Multi Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

Maintained references show a 5,000-metre combined range and 300-second lifetime for both variants, but those summary values should not be applied to every programmed limpet without checking the selected function.<ref name="edwiki" /> The dedicated controller pages document their own targeting and performance rules.

== Limpet programmes ==

All three programmes use ordinary limpets carried in a [[Cargo Rack]]. The module programmes each limpet when it is launched.

{| class="wikitable"
! Programme
! Direct purpose
|-
| [[Decontamination Limpet Controller|Decontamination]] || Removes caustic contamination and performs limited hull repair.
|-
| [[Repair Limpet Controller|Repair]] || Restores hull integrity on the launching ship or another valid ship.
|-
| [[Research Limpet Controller|Research]] || Extracts a tissue or biomatter sample from a supported alien vessel or spaceborne organism.
|}

Decontamination and repair limpets can be applied to the launching ship or to another valid ship. The research programme instead needs a supported target and returns a completed sample to the launching ship's cargo hold.<ref name="decon">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Decontamination_Limpet_Controller Decontamination Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref><ref name="repair">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Repair_Limpet_Controller Repair Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref><ref name="research">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Research_Limpet_Controller Research Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

Thargoid tissue samples are corrosive cargo. A [[Corrosion Resistant Cargo Rack]] protects the carrying ship while those samples remain aboard; ordinary cargo space is still required for both blank limpets and returned samples.

== Shared active-limpet pool ==

The four-limpet maximum is one shared pool. Two research limpets, one repair limpet, and one decontamination limpet fill the controller's capacity; the module does not provide four active limpets for each programme.<ref name="edcd" /><ref name="edwiki" />

Each programme retains its own valid targets and operating behaviour. The Xeno controller does not make a research limpet repair hull, give every function the largest displayed range, or remove the need to carry limpets as cargo.

== Fitting trade-offs ==

The module's advantage is access to three xeno-support functions from one optional-internal slot. This suits a ship that needs occasional caustic removal, hull repair, and biological sampling without dedicating three compartments to separate controllers.

The cost is a Class 3 compartment and either 10 or 15 tonnes of module mass. A ship built around one function can use a dedicated controller with different class, rating, mass, range, or output choices. The Xeno controller also has no collector programme, so it cannot recover free-floating materials or cargo.<ref name="roguey">Roguey, [https://roguey.co.uk/elite-dangerous/equipment/internal/xeno-multi-limpet-controller/ Xeno Multi Limpet Controller], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

== Engineering and acquisition ==

No Engineer blueprints or Experimental Effects are currently documented for the Xeno Multi Limpet Controller. Blueprints available for some dedicated limpet controllers should not be assumed to apply to it.<ref name="inara-blueprints">INARA, [https://inara.cz/elite/blueprints/#tab_blueprintsequipmentstandard Blueprints and upgrades — standard equipment], accessed 23 September 2026.</ref>

The 3C and 3B variants are ordinary Outfitting purchases where stocked. Frontier's release notes introduced multi-limpet controllers through Outfitting, while EDSM's current module catalogue provides station-stock searches for both Xeno variants.<ref name="update9" /><ref name="edsm" />

Frontier released the controller to Horizons PC and console commanders on 9 December 2021, before the Live and Legacy galaxies separated.<ref name="horizons9">Frontier Developments, [https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/elite-dangerous-horizons-only-pc-console-update-09-12-2021-notes.595181/ Elite Dangerous: Horizons Only PC & Console Update 09/12/2021 notes], 9 December 2021.</ref><ref name="modes">Frontier Developments, [https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/elite-dangerous-update-14-and-beyond-live-and-legacy-modes Elite Dangerous Update 14 and Beyond: Live and Legacy Modes], 23 November 2022.</ref> It therefore exists in both modes, although their outfitting markets and wider galaxy states are separate.
